result.summary: A bar chart from a 2014 SAP-commissioned study by Forrester Consulting shows reasons why enterprise BI applications are sometimes not used. The top reason is 'Do not have all the data you need' at 45%, followed by 'Are too complex, complicated, cumbersome to use' at 32%, and 'Take too long to get results' at 29%.
key_facts: 32% of respondents say enterprise applications are too complex, complicated, cumbersome to use.
29% of respondents say enterprise applications take too long to get results.
The study surveyed 302 business and IT decision-makers who influence BI decisions.
Source: A commissioned study conducted by Forrester Consulting on behalf of SAP, March 2014.
